title: Control plane only indication information element

fields.name: CPOI value
fields.description: Control plane only indication value (CPOI). Bit 1: 0 = reserved, 1 = PDN connection can be used for control plane CIoT EPS optimization only. The value 0 is reserved. If received, it shall be interpreted as if the Control plane indication IE was not included in the message.

notes: Bits 4 to 2 of octet 1 are spare and shall be all encoded as zero.
